zh-CN.name: 减少动态效果
zh-CN.description: 尊重减少动态效果偏好，用静态状态保留相同信息与操作能力。
use_when: 用于解释或比较与当前任务相关的设计选择。
avoid_when: 不要将演示参数当作通用行业标准。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
检测 prefers-reduced-motion，关闭非必要位移、循环装饰和指针跟随。保留清晰状态反馈与完整操作能力，不把关闭动画当成隐藏信息。
专属演示：位移与静态状态对比；本地切换仅控制演示，系统减少动态偏好始终优先。 参数：演示时长 {duration_ms}ms。

en.name: Reduced Motion
en.description: Respect reduced-motion preferences and preserve equivalent information and actions in a static state.
use_when: Use to explain or compare design choices relevant to the current task.
avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.
en.prompt_template:
Respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling nonessential movement, ambient loops, and pointer tracking. Keep clear status feedback and all actions available.
Dedicated demonstration: Compare movement and static states; the local toggle controls only this demo, with system reduced-motion preferences taking precedence. Parameters: demo duration {duration_ms}ms.

sources.note: 原创概念说明与演示；参数为本项目示例，非标准值。
概念或实现参考，未复制外部正文与组件代码。
